cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(p1 C)
add_library(${PROJECT_NAME}_core STATIC src/a.c)
add_executable(cli src/main.c)
target_link_libraries(cli PRIVATE ${PROJECT_NAME}_core)
add_library(iface INTERFACE)
target_link_libraries(iface INTERFACE ${PROJECT_NAME}_core)
add_executable(tool2 tools/t.c)
target_link_libraries(tool2 PRIVATE iface)
add_library(outer INTERFACE)
target_link_libraries(outer INTERFACE iface)
add_executable(tool3 tools/t3.c)
target_link_libraries(tool3 PRIVATE outer)
